_written: 2026-10-08, BEFORE any strategy was run on TopstepX futures data (data used so far only for structural validation and roll/gap checks).

candidate.market: NQ / MNQ (CME E-mini / Micro E-mini Nasdaq-100)

test_A_exact.data: TopstepX NQ and MNQ 15-minute bars, 2026-01-20 -> 2026-04-15 (first ~14 sessions are look-back warm-up)
test_A_exact.spec: identical to the frozen research specification (09:30 open reference, hourly checks from 10:00, flat 16:00 ET)
test_A_exact.costs: baseline (1 tick slippage per side + commission) at actual prices (no normalization needed)
test_A_exact.criterion: Low statistical power (~45 tradable sessions). Reported; counts as FAIL only if total P&L is below the 5th percentile of the stationary-bootstrap distribution of dev+OOS daily P&L over the same number of sessions.

test_B_hourly_approximation.data: TopstepX NQ and MNQ 1-hour bars, 2025-03-21 -> 2026-04-15 (~13 months)
test_B_hourly_approximation.spec: 1h bars are aligned to the clock hour, so the 09:30 open is not observable. Approximation: session reference open = open of the 09:00 ET bar; same hourly checks (10:00..15:00 closes), same parameters, flat at 16:00 ET.
test_B_hourly_approximation.calibration: The same approximation is run first on Dukascopy US100 H1 bars (2013-2023) to establish its expected Sharpe; this uses only already-consumed development/OOS data.
test_B_hourly_approximation.criterion: PASS requires: baseline-cost Sharpe > 0 AND total P&L > 0 on NQ; MNQ must agree in sign. FAIL otherwise -> candidate rejected.

no_retuning: No parameter, filter or rule may be changed after observing these results. If the test fails, the candidate is rejected and the final-test data is declared contaminated.
